newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Glorious Sun up further as China conc.
newsitem.headline: Glorious Sun up further as China conc.

text.p: Shares of casual wear maker and retailer Glorious Sun Enterprise Ltd continued to surge on Thursday on buying of China-concept stocks, brokers said.
"Investors who want to tap the growing China retail market were seen accumulating the stock, especially as its products were seen well received in China," said a local sales manager.
Glorious Sun shares rose HK$0.25 or 7.94 percent to HK$3.40 in late trade after touching a new high of HK$3.475 on volume of 3.45 million shares worth HK$115.17 million.
Shares of Glorious Sun had risen HK$1.55 or 96.88 percent by Wednesday's close since its listing on September 17.
